# Fiji

> [!summary] Data available
> Thin and skewed to Indo-Fijian food: [[WorldCuisines]] lists 5 shared South Asian dishes and [[FmLAMA]] 2 dishes (thali, *tavioka*). Traditional medicine is better: [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] 143 records; plants from [[CMAUP]] (91) and [[NPASS]] (24). No FCT; compounds via [[Global]].

## Foods & dishes
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 5 dishes, none Fiji-only, all Indo-Fijian (dal bhat, khichdi, jalebi, paratha, murukku).
- [[FmLAMA]]: 2 dishes (26 rows): thali and *tavioka* (cassava). iTaukei dishes (lovo, kokoda) are absent. [[Food.com Recipes and Interactions]] has only region tags (`polynesian`, `micro-melanesia`).

## Ingredients & food composition
- No Pacific FCT in the vault or `Backlog/`; [[USDA FoodData Central]] or [[FooDB]] (which has taro, cassava, breadfruit, coconut) are the fallback. [[CMAUP]]: 91 plants.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: **143 records (94 taxa)**: wounds, stomach ache, thrush, dysentery, fractures, childbirth (e.g. *Piper puberulum*).
- [[NPASS]]: 24 pairs. [[KNApSAcK Family]]: flag page. Global backbone via [[Global]].

## Gaps
- iTaukei food culture has no dish, recipe or QA coverage; no Pacific Islands food composition table; no kava entry in FooDB.
